subject: Discovery recap: multi-tenancy controls and quotas
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <spatel@fintechco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap: multi-tenancy controls and quotas

Sam — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our convo + proposed next steps so we’re aligned. Let me know if I missed anything.

Key pain points you called out:
- Per-tenant rate limiting: you need hard per-customer token/request limits to prevent noisy tenants from impacting others.
- Quotas and tiering: customers on different tiers require different throughput and cost accounting.
- Routing/policy controls: need per-customer routing to different model tiers (fast/cheap/accurate) and ability to pin models per account.
- Observability: token-level cost visibility and SLO alerts tied to tenant usage.

Current stack:
- Frontend: React web app with server-side orchestrator on GCP
- Models: mix of hosted LLMs + internal microservices for PII filtering
- Auth: Okta for SSO, Cloud KMS for key storage

Success criteria for POC (what would make this a win):
1) Enforce per-tenant rate limits and quotas without impacting baseline latency for others.
2) Ability to route requests by tenant to different model profiles and record per-tenant cost.
3) Demonstrate predictable tail latency under a mixed-tenant workload.
4) Integration with Okta + ability to use tenant IDs from your tokens.

Proposed next steps:
- Redwood to run a quick proof-of-concept: enable per-tenant rate limiting + a small routing policy for 10 test tenants (2/3/5 qps tiers).  Timeline: ~2 weeks to stand up + one-week test window.
- Schedule a demo of the admin console and routing/quotas flows — proposed Wed 3pm PT (I’ll send a calendar invite).
- Provide SOC2 summary and mutual action plan (attached).

Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf (summary stub), MAP_20260225.xlsx (mutual action plan template)

Thanks — I’ll loop Ben in to own the POC setup and Lauren for pricing/tiers.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: (415) 555-0168 | dylan.brooks@redwood.com

Cc: Rahul Singh <rsingh@fintechco.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: multi-tenancy controls and quotas

Thanks Dylan — this looks right and covers what we discussed. A few clarifications:
- For quotas, we’ll need both token-based quotas (monthly) and concurrent request limits (per-second burst protection).
- Routing: would like the ability to set fallback rules when a higher-tier model is unavailable.

We’re available for the demo Wed 3pm PT — please send invite. Also can you share an estimated ballpark for pricing (dev POC and projected monthly for ~50 tenants)?

Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Platform Engineering | FinTechCo
spatel@fintechco.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <spatel@fintechco.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 08:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: multi-tenancy controls and quotas

Sam — appreciate the notes. I’ll own the POC implementation with Dylan and work through the routing and quota configs. Quick notes on approach:
- Rate limiting: we’ll implement tenant-level token and request-rate limits. Token quotas will be enforced monthly with configurable top-ups; request-rate limits enforced at the gateway for burst control.
- Routing/fallbacks: implement policy chain where tenant -> preferred model profile -> fallback chain. Fallbacks can be region- or latency-based.
- Telemetry: we’ll stream tenant-level events to a per-tenant cost dashboard; can send CSV export for your billing system.

I attached a draft mutual action plan (MAP_20260225.xlsx) that outlines milestones, owners, and success criteria.

Next actions from our side:
1) I’ll provision a sandbox with routing and two model profiles (fast/accurate) — target: 2 business days.
2) Dylan will send the demo invite and pricing ballpark by EOD.
3) Post-demo we’ll run a 7-day load test with sample tenants you provide.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
